## Houston v0.6.7

- Continue with suggestions now scroll with a mouse wheel, while trackpad controls keep working.
- The Routines tab can recover from certain damaged saved files instead of staying unavailable.
- Cloud agents open faster, and files, skills, integrations, and other actions can work without waiting for a sleeping agent to wake.
- Stability and polish improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS does not always replace an app that is running.
